# function: appsync_source_api_association

Builds the ARN for `appsync` `sourceApiAssociation`:

```
arn:${Partition}:appsync:${Region}:${Account}:apis/${MergedGraphQLAPIId}/sourceApiAssociations/${Associationid}
```

The partition, region and account fields come from the configuration file (`.arn.hcl`, or the path in `ARN_CONFIG`). The remaining placeholders are the arguments, in template order.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# arn:aws:appsync:ap-northeast-1:111111111111:apis/merged-graph-qlapi-id/sourceApiAssociations/associationid
output "appsync_source_api_association" {
  value = provider::arn::appsync_source_api_association("merged-graph-qlapi-id", "associationid")
}
```

## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
appsync_source_api_association(merged_graph_qlapi_id string, associationid string, options map of string...) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `merged_graph_qlapi_id` (String) Value for `${MergedGraphQLAPIId}` in the ARN template.
1. `associationid` (String) Value for `${Associationid}` in the ARN template.
<!-- variadic argument generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `options` (Variadic, Map of String) Optional overrides: `account` (the name of an `account` block in the configuration file), `account_id` (a literal account id), `region` and `partition`. At most one options map may be given. An unrecognized key, or a value set to an empty string, is an error; omit an option, or set it to `null`, to use the default.
